name: Samurai Jupiter
source:
Main character returns to his home town for the first time in many years. He helps Jupiter to repel enemy attack and gets involved in the struggle. Every day is different in the company of mysterious classmate Waruru and girl Rikako who Jupiter brought from the future. What awaits him?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公时隔多年首次回到故乡。他帮助Jupiter击退敌人进攻，由此卷入斗争。神秘同学Waruru，以及Jupiter从未来带来的少女Rikako陪伴在他身边，每一天都不尽相同。等待他的究竟是什么？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
